regions.name: Thornwall
regions.description: A timber-palisade town of three hundred souls at the River Seil crossing.

regions.name: Seil's Crossing
regions.description: An ancient stone bridge over the River Seil, older than the kingdom itself.

regions.name: Ashenford
regions.description: A cluster of homesteads around a communal well beneath the Ashfall Ridge.

regions.name: Greywood Edge
regions.description: The western boundary of settled land, where the old forest begins.

factions.name: Crown Watch
factions.description: The kingdom's garrison force in the Westmarch, thin-stretched and under-supplied.

factions.name: Seil Compact
factions.description: An informal alliance of frontier settlers who believe they must protect their own.

npcs.name: Corin Blackthorn
npcs.role: Lone ranger of the Greywood fringe

npcs.name: Old Gerren
npcs.role: Chapel keeper of the Quiet God

threads.name: The Greywood Silence
threads.description: Something has changed in the old forest. Game has fled, sound behaves strangely, and two people are missing.

threads.name: The Bridge Dispute
threads.description: The Crown Watch has begun taxing crossings at Seil's Crossing. The Compact argues no one owns the bridge.

threads.name: The Ridge Mines
threads.description: Miners at Ashenford have broken into an older tunnel system. Warden Maren sealed the entrance, but questions remain.
